body:
Its early in the morning and I hear my alarm ringing, I wake up and start preparing for the two final exams I had that day. Before anything, I take 500mg of L-tyrosine like I do every once in a while.  Its now 12pm the only meal Ive had so far is a cup of oatmeal, I am beginning to lose focus on my studying so  I take 50mg of caffeine in pill form ( this is a really weak dose for me because there are days where I work out with 400mg of this stuff in my system).
I start my first exam at 1:40 and finish at 3:30. I was quite disappointed on how I performed but I tried to keep a positive mindset for my second exam at 5pm. At 5pm I start my second exam and finish it at 8pm, it was a hard one but I aced it.  After the exam a few friends and I decided to go to a bar and celebrate the end of our fall 2015 semester so we went to this chill spot off campus and I had a bottle of beer (corona extra) and stuffed my face with about 15 mild wings. We were all feeling great so three of us decided to smoke some marijuana which we did in a friends car. The 3 of us smoked a dime (0.8g I think) I remember taking several hits, maybe 6-9 times and every time, I held the smoke in my lungs for 3-5 seconds.
I look at the time and it now 11pm, the music we were listening to sounded amazing, my laughter became uncontrollable at one point. It was at this point that I realized that I was beyond baked, although I had smoked a lot more on other occasions,  I honestly hadnt been this high before so I told my friends to drive me home.
I get back to my suite, four other suitemates are in the living room watching tv, I say hi to them and walk into my room. This was when things began to go downhill, I felt drowsy and uneasy, I tried laying down but my heart was pounding really fast. I then tried to eat some leftover wings I had but couldnt, I then decided to take a shower to see if Id feel better. I walked into the bathroom but then I decided to take a shit first because I felt constipated. I sat on the toilet and I clenched really really hard, all of a sudden my whole body began to shake as if I was having an epileptic attack, my heart rate seemed like it was at 200bpm, I could barely move, my whole body was stiff
my whole body began to shake as if I was having an epileptic attack, my heart rate seemed like it was at 200bpm, I could barely move, my whole body was stiff
, I looked at my arms and my veins had enlarged and popped out, I also looked down at my penis and it had shrunk considerably, it was flaccid but when I touched it , it was stiff.  At this point I was beyond terrified, I had never experienced anything like this, my first thought was that I was having cardiac arrest, I thought to myself , shit man am dying, am gonna die in this bathroom all by myself.
I managed to make it to the living room and while crawling on the floor I yelled , call 911. And then I started sobbing, everyone was panicking; my friends were scared to call 911 because they knew I had been smoking and they themselves were fairly high too. They helped me up and took me to my room and asked me to lay down. I asked one of them to check my pulse, he tried but he couldnt because my whole body was vibrating, they then realized that something was really wrong so they called 911 immediately.  Moments later the cops arrived, I remember them asking if I was on any drugs, I just kept saying no the whole time. The paramedics then arrived and placed me on the stretcher. Moments later, I was in the ambulance, my whole body felt cold and stiff, my mouth was ridiculously dry and the little saliva left in my mouth felt so gooey. At this point I had accepted my faith, I was dying, I began to think of my mother, I didnt think about missing her but about how she was gonna feel when she heard the news that I was dead, she was going to be devastated because we had just spoken on the phone earlier about me coming home for Christmas. I thought about my friends and all the people I wasnt going to ever see again, I remember the paramedic trying to have a conversation with me but I was in a peaceful place, I didnt or I dont even think I could talk at this point. I wanted to call people and say goodbye or listen to one last song before I go but then I remembered that my phone died earlier that night.
I wake up all of a sudden and am still in the ambulance and alive, the paramedic was saying my heart rate, temperature and blood pressure is high, they opened my buttons and let me stay in the cold for a few seconds and then push me into the emergency room. At this point I am sort of convinced that I was going to live, the Doc came and asked me what I was on and I told him everything, he then gave me a shot of some drug (forgot the name) but he said it will calm me down.
I woke up at 4:30am and it was at this point that I was fully assured that I was going to live to see another day. Over all the years Ive spent on this earth and my years of smoking experience, I have never experienced fear like this before, everyone I have told this story to says that it was a panic attack and everything was just in my head but its hard for me to believe, especially that bathroom scene, I was 101% sure that it was real and I was dying.
This experience has changed the way I see life, I think Ive been given a second chance in life and I just thought Id share this with everyone.
